capabilities.title: Core Foundation and Contracts
capabilities.description: Provides project structure, domain contracts, deterministic primitives, eventing, and composition-root wiring required by all runtime journeys.
capabilities.boundary_rationale: Groups foundational contracts and infrastructure that are shared by multiple user journeys and independently reviewable as a platform boundary.

capabilities.title: Run Continuity and Resume
capabilities.description: Owns persistence, autosave, run-state transitions, Continue validation, blocked-state recovery, and deterministic resume boundaries.
capabilities.boundary_rationale: These requirements share the lifecycle handoff between an interrupted run and a valid resumed run, including persistence and recovery evidence.

capabilities.title: Combat Runtime and Deck Lifecycle
capabilities.description: Delivers deterministic card, deck, combat-resolution, status, damage, defeat, and Warrior runtime behavior through shared combat services.
capabilities.boundary_rationale: Groups the cohesive combat execution journey from deck entry through card play, turn resolution, damage ordering, and combat completion.

capabilities.title: Enemy Intent and Resolution
capabilities.description: Provides data-backed enemy construction, intent preview, deterministic enemy turns, structured multi-effect actions, and invalid-definition handling.
capabilities.boundary_rationale: Separates the enemy lifecycle from general combat execution because preview generation, enemy action resolution, and fallback behavior form a distinct reviewable handoff.

capabilities.title: Run Entry and Map Routing
capabilities.description: Owns new-run setup, difficulty and character selection, modular Act configuration, route generation, map state, legal traversal, and map-path UI wiring.
capabilities.boundary_rationale: Groups the player journey from starting a run through selecting configuration and navigating the route graph, with map ownership as the handoff boundary.

capabilities.title: Node Experiences and Rewards
capabilities.description: Delivers Reward, Shop, Rest, and Event interactions, card-pool offers, offer locking, route-owned completion, and reward-entry modification.
capabilities.boundary_rationale: These surfaces are distinct node journeys with their own selection, confirmation, persistence, and return-to-map handoffs.

capabilities.title: Combat Interaction and Feedback
capabilities.description: Owns combat scene presentation, targeting interaction, status and rule feedback, accessibility-preserving input, deck feedback, and combat UI wiring.
capabilities.boundary_rationale: Separates player-facing combat interaction and presentation from deterministic combat state ownership while preserving the runtime handoff.

capabilities.title: Relics, Powers, and Potions
capabilities.description: Provides relic definitions, acquisition and display, combat and run trigger effects, potion participation, and configured live relic behavior.
capabilities.boundary_rationale: Groups persistent and combat participant lifecycles that depend on shared trigger boundaries and have independent acquisition and effect handoffs.

capabilities.title: Settlement and Run Summary
capabilities.description: Owns stored-data-backed outcome, difficulty, route progress, reward, relic, and resume evidence on settlement and summary surfaces.
capabilities.boundary_rationale: These requirements converge on the post-run presentation handoff and must expose stored state without recomputation.

capabilities.title: Quality, Security, and Delivery Governance
capabilities.description: Provides smoke execution, quality gates, audit validation, traceability, architecture protection, security guards, signal validation, and scoped review governance.
capabilities.boundary_rationale: These are cross-cutting delivery controls with independent ownership and review gates rather than player-facing runtime outcomes.

capabilities.title: Localization and Accessibility
capabilities.description: Ensures translated content, non-empty localized UI text, and accessible focus and input behavior across the M1 surfaces.
capabilities.boundary_rationale: These requirements span several screens but share a distinct cross-surface user outcome and verification boundary.
